payload.entry: Baseline: bob-cli-8u tracked the pre-change 2026-10-17 exposure: unauthenticated root multivisor-rpc on 0.0.0.0:8051, root execution from Bryan-owned pipx code, and a world-readable root config with HTTP credentials. Fix deployed through reviewed gates: removed TCP 8051; runs multivisor-rpc as bryan on IPC; retains root administration via /tmp/supervisor.sock (root:bryan 0770); keeps authenticated HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8001 with rotated credentials; root config is root:root 0600; local Multivisor configs are bryan:bryan 0600; IPC bridge socket is bryan:bryan 0700. Verification: final install/restart passed and approved credential-safe verifier rerun passed (exit 0, output suppressed), including HTTP rejection, nobody denial, authenticated Multivisor, root@athena status, and supervised health. Direct checks as bryan succeeded: supervisorctl via the Unix socket reported both supervised programs RUNNING; ss showed only 127.0.0.1:8001 and no 8051; multivisor-rpc ran as bryan; stat confirmed config/socket modes. Constraints: Bryan retains intended admin access through the protected group socket, the authenticated HTTP endpoint remains loopback-only, and the Bryan-owned venv is used by the unprivileged RPC process. Earlier install/verifier attempts failed; later approved install/restart and verifier rerun passed. Their suppressed output does not identify the earlier causes. Credentials were not recorded.

Done: approved Athena install and restart passed; credential-safe verifier rerun passed. As bryan, authenticated supervisorctl over /tmp/supervisor.sock reports both managed programs RUNNING; no 8051 listener remains, 8001 is loopback-only, multivisor-rpc runs as bryan, and root/local configs plus IPC sockets have the verified protected ownership and modes. Baseline, fix, verification, and remaining constraints were recorded on this phase and bob-cli-8u. No credentials recorded.

payload.entry: Baseline (2026-10-21, as bryan on athena): /etc/cron.hourly/hourly_jobs and hourly_backup are root-owned symlinks resolving to bryan:bryan 0755 /home/bryan/db/bin/cron.jobs/cron.hourly/* (sha256 1a58a0eb... / ad286761...). Full chain inventoried: hourly_jobs execs bryan-owned prometheus_disk_space_textfile (fbf780f4...), hourly_backup sources bryan-owned backup.sh (fa5c49b0...); interpreters (/usr/bin/bash), rsync, and all PATH helpers are root-owned; /var/lib/prometheus/node-exporter is root:root 0755 (collector genuinely needs root); backup destination /mnt/hercules/backup is bryan:bryan 700 with root-owned rotations, source /home needs root for full read, so both jobs stay on root (user-crontab move would silently narrow coverage). Pre-change verifier run exits 1: both entrypoints FAIL as symlinks, bryan can open both for writing (proves bob-cli-96).

Prepared fix (tailnet repo, hosts/athena/root-cron/): /etc/cron.hourly entries become regular root:root 0755 files pinning PATH and sourcing /usr/local/lib/athena-cron/{backup.sh,prometheus_disk_space_textfile} by absolute path; lib is a reviewed copy with only hardening diffs (pinned #!/usr/bin/bash, PATH export, RSYNC=/usr/bin/rsync, absolute /usr/bin/sudo; rotation/filter/atomic-mv behavior byte-identical per diff). install_root_cron.py (root-only, baseline-guarded, atomic replace, manifest under /var/backups/bob-cli-an.2/, --rollback restores pre-change state into the backup dir) runs verify_root_cron.py itself post-install. Non-priv validation done: bash -n x4, py_compile x2, installer baseline/validate_payload OK and refuses non-root, sim install/rollback/reinstall incl. same-second backups and cron-dir cleanliness, scratch backup (2 runs, rotation+hardlinks, exit 0), scratch collector (exit 0, correct prom format). Remaining: privileged gate (install, verify incl. nobody probes, run-parts --test, live exercise of both entrypoints, restore-sample cmp) then close this phase; task bob-cli-96 stays open for the lander.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: /etc/cron.daily, weekly, and monthly contain the same bryan-symlink shape (daily_backup, daily_jobs, weekly_backup, weekly_jobs) executing as root; this phase migrates only the two hourly chains per bob-cli-96 scope.

Cautionary evidence (2026-10-21): an exercise dry-run as bryan accidentally executed the LIVE hourly_backup chain (not a scratch copy) against the real BACKUP_DIR. It failed safe exactly as designed for non-root: every destructive op hit Permission denied, exit 1, zero rotation changes (hourly/backup.txt still 1792617853, rotation mtimes untouched). This independently proves the backup genuinely requires root and cannot move to a user crontab. Side effect was limited to throwaway .hourly staging (91 bryan-owned partial entries); cleaned unprivileged via chmod+rm, staging dir now absent, rotations verified intact. Lesson recorded: validate backup logic only with overridden BACKUP_DIR (done, exit 0) or as root post-install.

Validation (2026-10-22, athena, as bryan): gate sudo-226fbe88 ledger = install exit 0 (46/46), verify exit 0 (46/46 incl. bryan+nobody denial probes), schedule lists both jobs. Live now: /etc/cron.hourly files byte-identical to tailnet hosts/athena/root-cron source, run-parts lists both, exporter fresh (~590s), hourly marker fresh (~274s, root-owned rotations), non-priv verify 41/41 (nobody probes SKIP as bryan). exercise exit 2: COLLECTOR 0, BACKUP 16 (rsync vanished-file code 24 on active .sase scratch + rm staging race during 344s full /home backup), RESTORE_SAMPLE_OK. Backup logic is byte-identical to pre-change baseline (hardening only), so this is the pre-existing bob-cli-1a exit-24 flake, not a hardening regression; regular hourly runs since succeed (marker fresh). Re-exercise now hits TOO_SOON guard (marker <30min) for fast EXERCISE_OK via gate.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: treat rsync exit 24 (vanished files) as warning-not-fatal in backup.sh so hourly /home rotations commit instead of discarding on active-tree churn — detail: exercise BACKUP exit 16 driven by rsync code 24 on short-lived .sase scratch files plus an rm staging race; restore sample still matched; cites canceled bob-cli-1a; explicitly out of this phase scope (byte-identical rotation behavior preserved per bob-cli-96).

payload.entry: Phase progress 2026-10-23: endpoint-to-client matrix verified by config + read-only probes. Scrapes all local-static (no discovery): prometheus/node/pushgateway/rfserver via 127.0.0.1, clipster_server 127.0.0.1:9102 DOWN (no listener; clipster binary absent, no X). Push clients: none (pushgateway API empty). Dashboards: none (no grafana, only established conns are loopback scrapes). Alertmanager 127.0.0.1:9093 active, config intact; apt-health textfiles fresh (today) and athena_apt_health_last_run_timestamp_seconds present. State: 9090/9091/9100 already loopback via systemd drop-ins installed 2026-10-22 (processes run with --web.listen-address=127.0.0.1). NEW change by this agent: rfserver /metrics :9101 was 0.0.0.0 (prometheus_client default) exposing unauthenticated metrics; edited /home/bryan/db/bin/main/rfuncs/server.py to pc.start_http_server(9101, addr=127.0.0.1) and restarted tools:rfserver via user supervisorctl (new pid 3181265); ss confirms 127.0.0.1:9101, prometheus target rfserver UP, local 200, tailnet/LAN probes refused on 9090/9091/9100/9101/9093. Rollback: revert that one line and restart tools:rfserver (no sudo needed). promtool: config valid, 13 rules valid. md5 baselines recorded for prometheus.yml, alertmanager.yml, both rules files, three drop-ins, server.py. Remaining: privileged firewall-policy read + daemon-reload via sase_sudo gate.
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Remove or repair the perpetually-down clipster_server :9102 Prometheus scrape job — clipster binary is not installed and no X session exists so nothing can ever listen on 9102.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Decide the access boundary for rfserver function port :23401 (token-authed /sendmail) — still 0.0.0.0 because RFSERVER_HOSTNAME=bbugyi.ddns.net (public DDNS) so loopback-binding may break local pymail callers; needs client inventory + firewall stance before any rebind.

Verified 2026-10-23 post-sudo: daemon-reload exit 0, all four units active/running NeedDaemonReload=no; ss 9090/9091/9100/9101/9093 on 127.0.0.1 only no IPv6 wildcards (:23401 still 0.0.0.0 intentional); nft athena_monitoring lo-accept else drop; curl 200 loopback x5, 000 refused on 100.87.31.114 and 192.168.1.156 x5; targets node/prometheus/pushgateway/rfserver UP (clipster DOWN known stale); athena_apt_health present; no emails sent; verification note added to bob-cli-97 (left open), parent epic left open.

LANDER FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (bob-cli-an.land): (1) an.2 #3, daily/weekly/monthly root cron bryan-writable chains: created bob-cli-au (medium). (2) an.2 #6, rsync exit-24 discards rotations: semantic duplicate of canceled bob-cli-1a. Recorded a +1 with post-close evidence (hourly rotations land only every third run; latest 04:24 at 12:25; daily, weekly, and monthly also stale), which reopened it as READY. (3) an.3 #2, dead clipster_server scrape: created bob-cli-ax (small). (4) an.3 #3, rfserver 0.0.0.0:23401 boundary: created bob-cli-aw (large); 23401 is reachable from apollo. (5) an.4 #4, apollo .bob/gkeep/migrate-tasks/*.json: declined as a task, because docs/gkeep.md defines these as bob gkeep migrate-tasks crash-recovery and commit-retry receipts (machine-local state). The lander recorded that exclusion justification in docs/vault-git-sync.md, as the proposal's own alternative asked. (6) Lander discovery: Bryan's user supervisord serves unauthenticated multivisor-rpc on 0.0.0.0:8052 (reachable from apollo), and Multivisor web binds 0.0.0.0:8100. Created bob-cli-av (medium). Epic-caused remainder fixed by the lander: phase an.3 never committed its tailnet install source. It was recovered from the workspace-11 SASE rescue patch, verified byte-identical to all seven installed files, and staged in tailnet hosts/athena/monitoring with README install, verify, and rollback steps plus tailnet README index rows.

Verified all five phases (an.1-an.5 closed) and closed their tasks with live evidence: 8u, 96, 97, 1g, and 9o. Supervisor: no 8051 listener, 8001 loopback-only, root config 0600, bridge running as bryan over IPC; source in tailnet 6af6375. Root cron: hourly entries are root-owned regular files, byte-identical to tailnet dbb7368, and rotations still land. Monitoring: 9090, 9091, 9100, 9101, and 9093 are loopback-only; remote probes from apollo are denied; the nft boundary service is enabled. The phase's uncommitted tailnet source was recovered from the SASE rescue patch, verified byte-identical to the installed files, and staged for commit. Vault: 4b62d0ac's 80 paths are on origin/master, and no authored-class path remains ignored. Highlight IDs: 51ad4f4c stable planner with regression tests; later epic bob-cli-ap's tucked groups build on the same plan; highlights_ref 596/596 pass; just check exits 0 on c07a65cc; just docs-check passes. Integration: post-start commits reviewed; only bob-cli-ap touched epic code, and it already uses the ID plan. Follow-ups: created bob-cli-au, av, aw, and ax; reopened bob-cli-1a by +1; declined the migrate-tasks receipts task and recorded the exclusion in docs/vault-git-sync.md (see the epic triage note). No epic symbols.

CONTINUATION (bob-cli-an.land, 2026-10-23): fresh enumeration after this landing found 155 unresolved tasks (151 ready, 4 snoozed: 3o, 6q, aa, ah; none claimed or in progress). Successor epic 'Backlog batch 2: Athena root, listener, and backup hardening plus reference ID allocation' was authored and submitted through sase plan propose (scratch sase_plan_backlog_batch2_athena_hardening_and_ref_ids.md). It owns exactly bob-cli-au (periodic-cron), bob-cli-1a (backup-rotation, after periodic-cron), bob-cli-av (user-supervisor), bob-cli-aw (rfserver-port, after user-supervisor), and bob-cli-8o (ref-id-allocation), with one reviewer decision (multivisor_web_access, default tailnet) and the verbatim continuation contract. Ranking: security first (au, av, aw), backup content loss next (1a), then the top silent identity defect (8o, chosen over 9a on age and live-vault impact). Next candidates: 9a, 8a, 79, al, 2q, ax; heavily corroborated 6m, 6v, 6w, 7i; detection 8r, 9x. The backlog campaign is not complete.
